title: Classification Candidate (Legacy Jurisdiction Projection)
description: Legacy per-jurisdiction AA projection schema. The canonical authored AA artifact is now the AA bundle; this schema remains as a machine-facing jurisdiction decision contract for derived outputs and compatibility.

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction this candidate applies to. 'universal' only when no jurisdiction divergence exists.

hs_code_final_candidate.description: The AA's recommended HS code for this component in this jurisdiction

classification_basis.description: Summary of the determinative logic (e.g. 'GRI 1 + Pre-GRI Filter (Section XVII Note 2(f))')

authority_chain.description: Ordered chain of authorities that informed this classification

ruling_used_for_classification.description: Ruling ID if a ruling modified or confirmed the PTA baseline. Null if PTA alone.

override_applied.description: True only when a ruling produced a different code than PTA and all four override conditions were met

override_type.description: Nature of the ruling's effect on the PTA baseline

jurisdiction_divergence.description: True when this component classifies differently in different jurisdictions. Requires separate AA records per jurisdiction.

contradictions_surfaced.description: ContradictionRecord IDs for contradictions related to this component

d_ruling_handoff_items.description: Descriptions of items queued for D-RULING from this classification

stability_note.description: Explanation of why this classification is stable/contested/fragile

requires_human_review.description: Must be true for all contradicted and jurisdiction-divergent cases

track_1_result.description: Section XV Note 2 (parts of general use) check result

track_2_result.description: Section XVII Note 2(f) (electrical exclusion) check result

track_3_result.description: GRI 3(b) essential character analysis result. 'not_applicable' for non-composite goods.

essential_character_reasoning.description: Required when track_3_result is 'pass'. Explains which sub-component gives essential character and why.

source_docs.description: All source_doc filenames from PTA, PRA, DA records that informed this candidate

d_class_eng_entity.description: The D-CLASS-ENG entity this classification is for
